```{r load-stadester-json, include=FALSE}
GAZETTEER_JSON_FILE <- "soviet_post_stalin_settlements.json"
gaz_map <- jsonlite::fromJSON(GAZETTEER_JSON_FILE, simplifyVector = FALSE)
settlements_list <- unname(gaz_map)

first_year_num <- function (arg0_s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(arg0_s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return(99999)
  return(min(yrs))
}
last_year_num <- function (arg0_s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(arg0_s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return(-99999)
  return(max(yrs))
}

ord_idx <- order(
  vapply(settlements_list, first_year_num, numeric(1)),
  vapply(settlements_list, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1))
)
settlements_list <- settlements_list[ord_idx]

fmt_other_names <- function (arg0_s) {
  onames <- unlist(arg0_s$other_names)
  if (length(onames) == 0) return("-")
  clean_vec <- unique(as.character(onames))
  clean_vec <- clean_vec[nzchar(clean_vec) & tolower(clean_vec) != tolower(arg0_s$name)]
  if (length(clean_vec) == 0) clean_vec <- unique(as.character(onames))
  return(paste(head(clean_vec, 2L), collapse = "; "))
}

fmt_year_lbl <- function (arg0_y) {
  y <- as.numeric(arg0_y)
  if (y < 0) return(paste0(abs(round(y)), "BC"))
  return(paste0(round(y), "AD"))
}

fmt_span <- function (arg0_s) {
  y1 <- first_year_num(arg0_s)
  y2 <- last_year_num(arg0_s)
  if (y1 == y2) return(fmt_year_lbl(y1))
  if (y1 < 0 && y2 < 0) return(paste0(abs(y1), "-", abs(y2), "BC"))
  if (y1 > 0 && y2 > 0) return(paste0(y1, "-", y2, "AD"))
  return(paste0(fmt_year_lbl(y1), " - ", fmt_year_lbl(y2)))
}

fmt_num_eu <- function (arg0_val) {
  if (is.null(arg0_val) || is.na(arg0_val)) return("-")
  v <- as.numeric(arg0_val)
  if (v >= 1000) {
    s <- sprintf("%.1fk", v / 1000.0)
    s <- gsub("\\.", ",", s)
    return(s)
  }
  return(as.character(round(v)))
}

fmt_coord_pair <- function (arg0_coords) {
  lat <- as.numeric(arg0_coords[[1]])
  lon <- as.numeric(arg0_coords[[2]])
  lat_s <- paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", abs(lat))), if (lat >= 0) "°N" else "°S")
  lon_s <- paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", abs(lon))), if (lon >= 0) "°E" else "°W")
  return(paste0(lat_s, ", ", lon_s))
}

fmt_pop_series <- function (arg0_s, arg1_ymin = -99999, arg2_ymax = 99999) {
  pop_map <- arg0_s$population
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(pop_map))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(pop_map))
  keep <- which(yrs >= arg1_ymin & yrs <= arg2_ymax)
  if (length(keep) == 0) return("-")
  parts <- vapply(keep, function (idx) {
    paste0(fmt_year_lbl(yrs[idx]), ": ", fmt_num_eu(vals[idx]))
  }, character(1))
  return(paste(parts, collapse = "; "))
}

get_pop_window_val <- function (arg0_s, arg1_ymin, arg2_ymax) {
  pop_map <- arg0_s$population
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(pop_map))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(pop_map))
  keep <- which(yrs >= arg1_ymin & yrs <= arg2_ymax)
  if (length(keep) == 0) return("-")
  idx <- keep[which.max(yrs[keep])]
  return(fmt_num_eu(vals[idx]))
}
```

```{r load-region-labels, include=FALSE}
  vapply(sum_json$regions, function (r) strsplit(as.character(r$name), " (", fixed = TRUE)[[1]][1], character(1)),
  vapply(sum_json$regions, function (r) as.character(r$id), character(1))
)
get_rid <- function (arg0_s) {
  k <- as.character(arg0_s$key)
  if (k %in% names(reg_map_41)) {
    return(unname(reg_map_41[[k]]))
  }
  return("")
}
fmt_reg_short <- function (arg0_s) {
  rid <- get_rid(arg0_s)
  if (nzchar(rid) && rid %in% names(reg_lbl_map)) {
    return(reg_lbl_map[[rid]])
  }
  return(as.character(arg0_s$country))
}
```

# Settlement Gazetteer Overview (1953AD - 1991AD)

This supplementary settlement gazetteer accompanies the regional demographic literature review for the post-Stalin Soviet Union (1953AD - 1991AD) and compiles 292 individual urban, industrial, scientific, naval, resource-frontier, and evacuated settlements across all forty-one Late-Soviet regions of the Estonian SSR (Region 1), Latvian SSR (Region 2), Lithuanian SSR (Region 3), Moldavian SSR (Region 4), Kaliningrad Oblast RSFSR exclave (Region 5), Byelorussian SSR (Regions 6-8), Ukrainian SSR (Regions 9-15), and mainland RSFSR (Regions 16-41) [@tssu_1962_perepis_1959; @tssu_1972_perepis_1970; @tssu_1984_perepis_1979; @goskomstat_1991_perepis_1989; @goskomstat_1992_demograficheskiy_ezhegodnik_1991]. Every entry records verified geographic coordinates, historical Soviet or pre-Soviet toponyms and functional designations, modern republic attribution (Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Moldova, Belarus, Ukraine, or Russia), and positive integer population series across the six post-Stalin benchmark years (1953AD, 1959AD, 1970AD, 1979AD, 1989AD, and 1991AD, plus 1986AD pre-evacuation benchmarks for settlements inside the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone) [@lappo_1997_geografiya_gorodov; @rowland_1996_russia_secret_cities_zato; @iaea_2006_chernobyl_environmental_consequences].

To facilitate regional cross-referencing across all forty-one Late-Soviet regions, Section 2 tabulates the 47 enumerated settlements of the Baltic SSRs (Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania), the Moldavian SSR, and the Kaliningrad Oblast Baltic Fleet exclave (Regions 1-5, including Snieckus/Visaginas, Sillamae, Tiraspol, Ribnita, Comrat, and Baltiysk), Section 3 tabulates the 82 settlements of the Byelorussian SSR (Regions 6-8) and Ukrainian SSR (Regions 9-15, including the 1954AD Crimean transfer and the 1986AD Chernobyl Exclusion Zone), Section 4 tabulates 107 settlements across European Russia, Leningrad-Novgorod-Pskov (Region 17), the Karelian and Komi ASSRs, the *Nechernozemye* depopulation ring, the Volga-Kama and Ural ASSRs, the 1957AD restored North Caucasus and Kalmyk ASSRs, and declassified *ZATO* nuclear cities (Regions 16-30), Section 5 tabulates 56 settlements across the Yamalo-Nenets and Khanty-Mansi hydrocarbon okrugs, Western Siberia, the Angara-Yenisei hydro cascades, the Tuva, Buryat, and Yakut ASSRs, the Baikal-Amur Mainline (BAM), and the Russian Far East (Regions 31-41), and Section 6 provides the complete unified alphabetical directory across all forty-one regions.

# Baltic SSRs, Moldavian SSR, and Kaliningrad Exclave Directory (Regions 1 - 5)

```{r tab-western-ssrs-kaliningrad, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
west_ids <- c(
  "estonian_ssr_post_stalin",
  "latvian_ssr_post_stalin",
  "lithuanian_ssr_post_stalin",
  "moldavian_ssr_post_stalin",
  "kaliningrad_oblast_baltic_fleet"
)
sub_w <- Filter(function (s) get_rid(s) %in% west_ids, settlements_list)
sub_w <- sub_w[order(match(vapply(sub_w, get_rid, character(1)), west_ids), vapply(sub_w, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1)))]

df_w <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(sub_w, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1)),
  Region = vapply(sub_w, fmt_reg_short, character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(sub_w, function (s) fmt_coord_pair(s$coords), character(1)),
  Y1953 = vapply(sub_w, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1953, 1953), character(1)),
  Y1959 = vapply(sub_w, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1959, 1959), character(1)),
  Y1970 = vapply(sub_w, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1970, 1970), character(1)),
  Y1979 = vapply(sub_w, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1979, 1979), character(1)),
  Y1989 = vapply(sub_w, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1989, 1989), character(1)),
  Y1991 = vapply(sub_w, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1991, 1991), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
render_table_template(
  df_w,
  list(
    caption = "Settlement population histories across the Estonian, Latvian, Lithuanian, and Moldavian SSRs and the Kaliningrad Oblast exclave (Regions 1 to 5, 1953AD - 1991AD).",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Late-Soviet Region (1-5)", "Coordinates", "1953AD", "1959AD", "1970AD", "1979AD", "1989AD", "1991AD"),
    label = "tab:western-ssrs-kaliningrad"
  )
)
```

# Belarus and Ukraine Settlement Directory (Regions 6 - 15)

```{r tab-belarus-ukraine, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
sub_bu <- Filter(function (s) s$country %in% c("Belarus", "Ukraine"), settlements_list)
sub_bu <- sub_bu[order(vapply(sub_bu, function (s) paste0(sprintf("%02d", as.integer(sub("\\..*$", "", fmt_reg_short(s)))), "_", s$name), character(1)))]

df_bu <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(sub_bu, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1)),
  Region = vapply(sub_bu, fmt_reg_short, character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(sub_bu, function (s) fmt_coord_pair(s$coords), character(1)),
  Y1953 = vapply(sub_bu, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1953, 1953), character(1)),
  Y1959 = vapply(sub_bu, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1959, 1959), character(1)),
  Y1970 = vapply(sub_bu, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1970, 1970), character(1)),
  Y1979 = vapply(sub_bu, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1979, 1979), character(1)),
  Y1989 = vapply(sub_bu, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1986, 1989), character(1)),
  Y1991 = vapply(sub_bu, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1991, 1991), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
render_table_template(
  df_bu,
  list(
    caption = "Settlement population histories across the Byelorussian SSR and Ukrainian SSR, including 1986AD Chernobyl benchmarks (Regions 6 to 15, 1953AD - 1991AD).",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Late-Soviet Region (6-15)", "Coordinates", "1953AD", "1959AD", "1970AD", "1979AD", "1986/89AD", "1991AD"),

)
```

# Complete Alphabetical Settlement Directory (292 Settlements)

```{r tab-complete-directory, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
all_sorted <- settlements_list[order(vapply(settlements_list, function (s) as.character(s$key), character(1)))]

df_all <- data.frame(
  Key = vapply(all_sorted, function (s) as.character(s$key), character(1)),
  Region = vapply(all_sorted, fmt_reg_short, character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(all_sorted, function (s) fmt_coord_pair(s$coords), character(1)),
  Series = vapply(all_sorted, function (s) fmt_pop_series(s, 1953, 1991), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
render_table_template(
  df_all,
  list(
    caption = "Complete alphabetical settlement directory across all forty-one Late-Soviet regions of the western SSRs and the RSFSR (292 settlements, 1953AD - 1991AD).",
    col_names = c("Stadester Key", "Late-Soviet Region (1-41)", "Coordinates", "Benchmark Population Series (1953AD - 1991AD)"),
    label = "tab:complete-directory"
  )
)
```
